item.title: Obituary: Thomas J. Colao
item.description: In 2011, Mr. Colao brought his artistic precision to the oven when he opened Bivio Pizza Napoletana. He didn’t just make food; he shared his soul through his craft. His patrons saw him as a true artisan and a master of his trade who created what many called the best pizza in the world. The post Obituary: Thomas J. Colao appeared first on Montclair Local.
